hints.title: Unique Item Selection
hints.text: Each candidate integer base can be chosen at most once to contribute base^x to the target sum.

hints.title: Knapsack Form
hints.text: Model the problem as a 0/1 knapsack where items are base^x and the capacity is n.

hints.title: Reverse Iteration
hints.text: Traverse target sums downward from n to base^x to avoid reusing the same base multiple times.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: 0/1 Knapsack dynamic programming iterating target sums in descending order.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all combinations recursively exceeds time limits when n is up to 300.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n * n^(1/x)) time and O(n) space using a 1D DP table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Iterate backwards to preserve 0/1 item uniqueness without additional dimension overhead.
